name: Field Doctor-Style No Sugar Banana Porridge (Low FODMAP)
ingredients:
160 g Rolled Oats (GLUTEN FREE)
160 g Jumbo Oats (GLUTEN FREE)
49 g Oat Flour (GLUTEN FREE)
3 tbsp Banana Powder
1 tbsp Banana Pieces
1 tbsp Chia Seeds
1 1/2 tsp Vanilla Powder
3/4 tsp Cinnamon Ground
1/4 tsp Sea Salt
directions:
1. Dry mix: Stir together all dry ingredients until evenly combined.

2. Cook (per portion): Use about 1/8 of the dry mix. Cook with Low FODMAP milk alternative (e.g. lactose-free milk or suitable plant milk) or water, using roughly 150–200 ml liquid per portion, until creamy. Adjust thickness to taste.

3. Finish: Sweeten further only if needed. Cool leftovers; refrigerate up to 3 days. Reheat with a splash of liquid.
description: Inspired recreation of Field Doctor No Sugar Banana Porridge.
notes:
